meta.name: fal-ai-media
meta.description: Unified media generation via fal.ai MCP — image, video, and audio. Covers text-to-image (Nano Banana), text/image-to-video (Seedance, Kling, Veo 3), text-to-speech (CSM-1B), and video-to-audio (ThinkSound). Use when the user wants to generate images, videos, or audio with AI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI生成图片、视频和音频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成多种媒体内容
copy.tagline_en: Generate images, videos, and audio with AI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate diverse media content

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据文字描述生成图片、视频和音频，也能基于已有图片生成视频或为视频配乐。
howto.when: 当你要求生成图片、视频或音频时触发，例如说“生成一张图”、“创建视频”或“文字转语音”。

say.text: 帮我生成一张赛博朋克风格的城市日落图片。
根据这张照片生成一段5秒的视频，镜头缓慢拉远。
把这段文字转成语音：欢迎使用AI助手。
say.note: Claude 会调用 CSM-1B 模型生成语音。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate images, videos, and audio from text descriptions, and can also generate videos from existing images or add audio to videos.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate images, videos, or audio, e.g., saying 'generate an image', 'create a video', or 'text to speech'.

say_en.text: Generate a cyberpunk city sunset image.
say_en.note: Claude will use Nano Banana 2 model.

say_en.text: Create a 5-second video from this photo, slowly zooming out.
say_en.note: Claude will upload the image and use Seedance.

say_en.text: Convert this text to speech: Welcome to AI assistant.
